subject: general
question:
A beam of white light passes through a glass prism and a spectrum is obtained. Which of the following color components bends the most?

Green, Red, Indigo, Blue
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indigo**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, **Indigo** bends the most.
 
• When white light passes through a glass prism, the different colors (wavelengths) of light are refracted (bent) by different amounts due to their varying speeds in the medium. This phenomenon is called dispersion.
 
• This is because **shorter wavelengths of light (like violet and indigo) are refracted more than longer wavelengths (like red).**
 
• The **discovery of the bending of light** (also known as refraction) is often credited to the **Islamic scientist Ibn Sahl in the 10th century.**
 
• Which was later expanded upon by **Willebrord Snellius (Snell) in the 17th century**, leading to what we now call **Snell's Law.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's the general order of bending for the visible spectrum when passing through a prism:
 
 
• Red **(least bending)**
 
• Orange
 
• Yellow
 
• Green
 
• Blue
 
• Indigo
 
• Violet **(most bending).**
